appImport.title: Import from another app

hints.auto: Pick the export file and Termix works out which app it came from.
hints.termius: Termius has no export of its own. Pick a CSV made from its import template or by a Termius export tool. Columns like Label, Hostname/IP, Port, Username, Password, Groups and Tags are read.
hints.mobaxterm: In MobaXterm, right click User sessions and pick Export all sessions to file, or pick your MobaXterm.ini.
hints.putty: Export the sessions from the registry with reg export HKCU\Software\SimonTatham putty.reg and pick putty.reg.
hints.securecrt: In SecureCRT, use Tools, Export Settings and pick the XML file, or pick your Config/Sessions folder.
hints.mremoteng: Pick confCons.xml from the mRemoteNG folder in AppData. Saved passwords come along.

appImport.masterPasswordHint: This file is protected with a master password. It is only used to read the file.

fileImport.jsonHint: Pick a Termix JSON file. Hosts you already have, with the same address, port and username, are skipped. Up to 100 hosts at once.
